description: Lists the image IDs inside image group (DGS) 7499145, one of the three reels of koha:186990, Ayling's 'Revised register of the soldiers and sailors of New Hampshire in the War of the Rebellion, 1861-1866' (film 2319539). Captured live 2026-11-27 with dev/try-image-search.ts 7499145. Drives ut_search_images_np2: a DGS taken from catalog_search's film notes has real page images, so the agent must not say none are digitized. The substring predicate matches both the bare '7499145' and the zero-padded '007499145'. 484 images.
